intent: Generate version-addressed CakeML API wrappers for HOL4, HolSmtLib/Z3_TAC and TacticToe, then kernel-check source/API equivalence and exact wrapper compilation.

hol4.role: production wrapper proof stack; same qualified HOL4 pin reused from PR #59

cakeml.role: production wrapper target; same in-logic compiler pin qualified in PR #58/#59

lowering_classes.higher_order: defunctionalise to typed callback handle plus apply operation

invariants: production facade is generated from HOL4 sigobj plus explicit mandatory proof-automation signatures
all src/**/*.sig files are retained as a hashed audit inventory even when not public
every selected public declaration is classified
source path and blob digest are recorded for every declaration
no raw Poly/ML pointer or closure crosses the CakeML FFI
all decoding is total and malformed input returns Error
foreign calls are identified by stable operation IDs
generated wrapper theorem is closed except for the declared foreign-contract premise
exact CakeML compiler theorem is checked by HOL4
final production gate rejects axioms or oracle tags other than DISK_THM
generated wrapper calls use CakeML #(api_bridge) with the exact canonical operation id as FFI configuration bytes
the single native runtime entry is ffiapi_bridge; no per-operation native ABI symbol is required
CakeML checks the 16-byte minimum frame before invoking api_bridge
api_bridge successful returns preserve the supplied byte-array length
complex and polymorphic native values cross only as opaque handles
operation_index is globally contiguous and stored in the canonical API IR
unified CakeML output contains main; component projections remain library facades
service dispatch resolves operation_index through the canonical operation-name table
api_request and api_reply are explicit foreign-contract premises
verified service dispatch preserves the original 64-byte frame identity on valid and invalid operations
invalid service operations write status 2 into byte 0 in place

publication_gate.machine_safety_theorem: pending source-semantics/compile_correct composition; fail closed until kernel checked
publication_gate.foreign_runtime_correctness: assumed by explicit contract; not claimed by CakeML

abi.polymorphic_values: HOL4 UniversalType/PolyML universal-tag registry on the native side
required_foreign_properties: output length equals supplied buffer length
no writes outside the supplied buffer
malformed input returns an encoded error
no raw Poly/ML object address crosses the boundary

service.purpose: Expose generated wrapper behavior to whole-program CakeML semantics and compile_correct.
service.invalid_operation_behavior: write status byte 2 into the existing 64-byte frame and return the same frame
